The scene includes two articulated silver desk lamps, a sleek silver keyboard, and a trackpad. The lighting highlights the textures of the metal and adds soft shadows, enhancing realism. Rendered in 8K, cinematic detail, hyperreal texture, soft shadows and high-gloss depth. No logos or references to copyrighted characters.
